direction.evidence: Close the coverage gaps before release (Recommended)
direction.authority: Product direction only; exact identities, sources, aliases, forms and recipe-use payloads still require review.

completionCriteria: Every current market group has explicit pantry counterpart association for its supported food kinds, or unsupported/ambiguous offers are explicitly rejected rather than misidentified.
Counterpart associations remain separate from recipe-use compatibility and observed price identity; a market group never confers ownership of every member.
Generic defaults and optional precision follow the approved cooking-choice model, with exact No precedence and no inferred nutrition, portions, dietary guarantees or prices.
Review each existing blueprint scope before accepting a newly cataloged member. Specific requirements remain exact; a counterpart without a valid recipe use does not force a compatibility edge.
Retain current IDs and market history; new identity registry migrations and source assignments are additive and go through the existing review/rollout workflow.

keywordQualificationFindings.finding: Generic large/medium avocado or avocado-bag keywords do not prove Hass variety. Do not turn triage into a precise variety claim.
Fresh chicken breast wording alone does not prove boneless/skinless retail form. Admit price/recipe use only with suitable form evidence.
Head/fresh cabbage keywords alone do not prove green variety; avoid automatically admitting red or other cabbage identities.

The retained dataset names raw sweet potato and raw yam separately. Resolve intended retail yam terminology or require explicit evidence; the market keyword must not automatically establish botanical or cooking equivalence.

Per-recipe food/offer admission, actual store-pool preservation and full underlying offers before per-store selection; no cross-food price relabeling.
Tests for each named member, generic/variant No behavior, wrong form/style/flavor rejection, saved recipes, shopping aggregation and store-specific search links.
